quotes.tex:
There are collections $\cL_1$ and $\cL_2$ for which $\cL_1\cup \cL_2$ is not generatable such that:
            \begin{itemize}[itemsep=-1pt]
                \item[$\triangleright$]  $\cL_1$ is countable and non-uniformly generatable, without requiring any elements from the adversary
                \item[$\triangleright$] $\cL_2$ is uncountable and uniformly generatable, without requiring any elements from the adversary.
            \end{itemize}
